about.body: The AJ126 is a V6 (90° angle), 3.0L (2,995 cc), Petrol Supercharged engine used across Jaguar's 4 model range, in production 2013–2020. We rebuild every AJ126 to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The AJ126 is fitted across F-Type, XE, XF, XJ — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ126 is fitted across multiple Jaguar models, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation and specification. We confirm by registration or VIN before quoting or supplying anything.
